summary: The results highlight that gains shrink when measured against highly optimized existing code and that adopting a new layout adds complexity to writers. The community is debating whether the performance benefits justify a global format change and how to decouple FastLanes from PFOR proposals. The discussion centers on creating a higher‑level document that compares several numeric encodings—DELTA_BINARY_PACKED, PFOR, FastLanes, and potential optimizations—across speed, storage efficiency, and development effort. Antoine apologizes for earlier harsh remarks and emphasizes the importance of evaluating maintenance effort to move ideas into production.
